anchor_note: Clean quarter-end (REPD Q1 2026 = data through 31 Mar 2026); fixed, not derived from row dates. Matches constraint-costs FY-boundary logic.

target.source: Clean Power 2030 Action Plan (DESNZ, Dec 2024), p10 & p74: '43-50 GW of offshore wind ... in 2030'; range restated in DESNZ CfD reform consultation, 21 Feb 2025.

caveats: Trailing 12-month additions are dominated by a single project (Neart na Gaoithe, 450 MW = 100% of the window). Offshore wind commissions in multi-GW lumps years apart; this window caught a trough. The score is correct but acutely sensitive to commissioning timing — read alongside the pipeline bar and sparkline.

REPD records multi-phase projects as single entries and can lag commissioning of completed phases. Dogger Bank A&B (2.4 GW) remains Under Construction as neither phase has reached full commercial operation (per v0.5 M-15); correctly excluded from operational.

Scored against the government's 2030 capacity RANGE (43-50 GW), not a point target. Both endpoints shown. Slip years are far beyond 2030 and carry wide uncertainty — treat as 'well past 2030 at current pace', not as precise forecasts.
